safety.title: Before enabling a workflow
safety.isolation: In the implementation stage, the AI agent runs with full access and without asking for your approval. It works in a separate git worktree, not in your working tree.
safety.guardsIntro: To limit the risk, MDium applies several layers of guards:
safety.guardScreening: Input screening: before a stage starts, task text, issues and text attachments are checked for suspicious instructions, invisible characters and long encoded payloads.
safety.guardRuntime: Runtime guard: git push, writes outside the worktree, reading credentials, known upload commands, and changes to system, agent or git settings are blocked. Codex has no pre-execution hook, so its commands are stopped only after they have started.
safety.guardContainment: Containment: the agent's git cannot reach network remotes, and GitHub/GitLab tokens are disabled.
safety.guardPostCheck: Post-run check: changes to the shared git config, hooks or agent settings stop the stage and need your confirmation before a retry. Moves of your branches or HEAD only stop the stage.
safety.guardMergeReview: Before merging, changed configuration files (such as .github/, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md) are listed for your explicit review.
safety.limits: These guards cannot catch every dangerous operation. Obfuscated commands and data sent over the network in other ways may go undetected.
safety.noPush: Nothing is pushed. The results stay on a local branch until you review and merge them yourself.
